proposed_induced: Notes that alpha-2 agonists (guanfacine/clonidine) are renally cleared and may require dose adjustment or close monitoring in CKD.
Advises monitoring blood pressure and heart rate, as stimulants can elevate both and CKD patients frequently have concurrent hypertension.
States that first-line ADHD medications (methylphenidate, amphetamines, atomoxetine, bupropion) are primarily hepatically metabolized and generally safe in CKD without routine dose adjustment.
Recommends verifying current eGFR/renal function with the prescriber before initiating or switching to any new medication.
